ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "EV_Charging_Deal", OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal/Price Quote"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation/Review"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, ""), ISBLANK(Number_of_Sites__c), Number_of_Sites__c <= 0, ISBLANK(Number_of_Chargers__c), Number_of_Chargers__c <= 0, ISPICKVAL(Solution_Type__c, ""), ISBLANK(Target_Go_Live_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving this EV charging deal to Proposal or later, complete Deal Type, Number of Sites, Number of Chargers, Solution Type and Target Go-Live Date.
